_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: The other agents are double agents. Companion Memory works only for you.

front-door.text: It opens on hardware you own, and your records are stored and searched there.

sign-in.text: Sign in through Companion Portal, or with email if you prefer.

first-run-focus.text: First run asks what matters to you, then builds around that.

first-run-import.text: Import the exports you already own, then connect what keeps producing.

trust-dial.text: Cautious, balanced, or hands off — first run asks where you want it to sit.

feed.text: The feed opens on the day's suggested actions, with the summaries underneath.

memory-list.text: Everything you keep, in one list, newest first.

memory-detail.text: Every field is there — what happened, where it happened, and exactly when.

memory-search.text: Search narrows the whole store in place, and never leaves the appliance.

memory-map.text: Anything that happened somewhere also lands on the map.

memory-graph.text: The graph shows how your people, places and ideas actually connect, computed locally.

memory-stats.text: It tracks the shape of your memory: how much it holds, how far back it goes, and what it is mostly about.

insights.text: Your appliance reads the week and writes the summary itself, without sending anything out.

insight-detail.text: Every summary opens up: the day's rhythm, the patterns it found, the tags it assigned.

sources.text: After that, every new item lands on your own hardware.

recap.text: Local database. Local models. No account, and nothing to cancel.

close.text: One memory. Every agent you choose. Yours. At ci dot computer slash memory. UnCloud your life.

the-deal.text: An assistant is only useful if it remembers you. Where you live. Who your doctor is. When the house is empty.

the-catch.text: Which leaves one question. Where would all of that live? On hardware you will never see, under terms you did not write.

bring-it-home.text: Point it at the accounts you already have, and your mail, your calendar and your photos come home to a machine you own.

one-memory.text: Everything lands in one list, on one machine, newest first. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing leaves the box.

the-record.text: Open one, and the whole record is there. The place, the address, the exact coordinates.

ask-it.text: Ask it anything and the whole store narrows in place. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing leaves the box.

it-connects.text: It works out how your people, places and ideas connect — the context anything acting for you actually needs.

it-notices.text: It can turn the activity you store into useful summaries and patterns.

your-call.text: How much it does on its own is a dial you set. Cautious, balanced, or hands off.

your-traces.text: Two dozen services each hold a piece of it, and not one of them will hand you the whole.

how-it-works.text: Underneath it is one shape. Raw data in; people, places, things and events out.

your-agents.text: Then give every agent you choose the same memory. Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw.

ci-memory-30-ask-it.text: The other agents are double agents. Yours should not start from zero.

ci-memory-30-bring-it-home.text: Bring the mail, calendars, photos and files you choose home to a machine you own.

ci-memory-30-the-record.text: Open one, and the whole record is there.

ci-memory-30-it-notices.text: Find useful summaries and patterns across the activity you keep.

ci-memory-30-your-agents.text: Then give Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes and OpenClaw the same memory.

ci-memory-30-close.text: One memory. Every agent you choose. Yours. At ci dot computer slash memory.

ci-memory-bumper-double-agents-ask-it.text: The other agents are double agents. One memory. Yours.

perfect-recall.text: You already have a perfect memory. Every place, every person, every promise you made — all of it recorded. Just not by you.

your-biography.text: Now imagine all of it written up for you. Not a diary you have to keep — one that keeps itself, hourly, daily and weekly.

the-biography.text: And every day gets written up. What happened, and what was decided — by a model on your own hardware.

ci-memory-30-perfect-recall.text: You already have a perfect memory. It is just scattered across services you do not own.

ci-memory-30-the-biography.text: Every day gets written up for you, by a model you host.

ci-memory-bumper-perfect-recall-the-reco.text: Perfect recall. On hardware you own.
